decision: Selected the planar centroid of Fulton County tax parcel 09F260101070774 (4380 Stacks Rd # Rear, 20.979 acres, owner Vantage Data Centers GA11 LLC) as the project locator for the City of South Fulton's "Vantage - Stacks Rd" data-center project.
layer: Fulton County GIS "Tax Parcels" FeatureServer layer 0 (services1.arcgis.com/AQDHTHDrZzfsFsB5; tax year 2027 rows; layer data last edited 21 October 2026); native CRS NAD83 Georgia West ftUS (EPSG:2240).
identity_bridge: The City of South Fulton's COSF Data Centers layer (published 3 August 2026) lists project "Vantage - Stacks Rd" at 4380 Stacks Rd, owner "Vantage Data Centers Management Company, LLC", 23.65 acres, M2 zoning, a 696,981 sq ft data-center building and power substation; its mapped point lies inside parcel 09F260101070774, 155 m from the selected point.
The Fulton County parcel layer has exactly one parcel whose owner name begins with VANTAGE DATA: 09F260101070774 at 4380 Stacks Rd # Rear, owned by Vantage Data Centers GA11 LLC.
unresolved: The city gives 23.65 acres; the Vantage-owned parcel is 20.979 attribute acres. An adjoining 2.683-acre parcel at 0 Stacks Rd held by the South Fulton Development Authority (52 m from the city point) would make up the difference, but no record ties it to the project, so it is excluded from the locator.
The building, substation and cleared area within the parcel are not located; the point locates the Vantage-owned parcel.

computed.method: Planar centroid of the WGS84 (outSR=4326) Fulton County parcel polygon owned by Vantage Data Centers GA11 LLC (ESRI rings oriented: clockwise outer ring, counter-clockwise hole); cross-checked against the centroid of the native EPSG:2240 polygon transformed with pyproj; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.
